_comment: agentmux adapter for Claude Code. Merge the 'hooks' object into ~/.claude/settings.json (or try it with `claude --settings hooks.json`). Requires `agentmux` on PATH and jq. Commands run under sh -c, so they must stay POSIX sh. $PPID is the Claude Code process (verified 2026-11-16, Q-015). PreToolUse: AskUserQuestion -> waiting/input with the question (the dialog is on screen from that moment); any other tool -> working. PermissionRequest fires as the permission dialog opens -> waiting/permission with Tool(command|file|url); AskUserQuestion -> waiting/input. PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure -> working, which clears waiting once the dialog is answered. Notification: permission_prompt is ignored (it arrives ~6 s late, says only 'Claude needs your permission', and also fires for AskUserQuestion; PermissionRequest/PreToolUse already covered it); elicitation_dialog, elicitation_url_dialog, agent_needs_input -> waiting/input; other types (idle_prompt, auth_*, quota_*, ...) ignored so done stays done. Without notification_type (older Claude Code) the message is matched instead. Tested by test/core.sh.

hooks.command: q=$(jq -r 'select(.tool_name == "AskUserQuestion") | (.tool_input.questions[0].question // "Question")'); if [ -n "$q" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$q" | agentmux set waiting --reason input --msg - --harness claude --pid $PPID; else agentmux set working --harness claude --pid $PPID; fi

o=$(jq -r 'if .tool_name == "AskUserQuestion" then "input", (.tool_input.questions[0].question // "Question") else "permission", ((.tool_name // "tool") + "(" + ((.tool_input.command // .tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.url // .tool_input.pattern // "") | tostring | .[0:120]) + ")") end'); r=$(printf '%s\n' "$o" | head -n 1); [ -z "$r" ] || printf '%s\n' "$o" | sed 1d | agentmux set waiting --reason "$r" --msg - --harness claude --pid $PPID

o=$(jq -r '(.notification_type // "") as $t | (.message // "") as $m | (if $t == "" then (if ($m | test("ermission")) then "permission" else "input" end) elif $t == "elicitation_dialog" or $t == "elicitation_url_dialog" or $t == "agent_needs_input" then "input" else "" end), $m'); r=$(printf '%s\n' "$o" | head -n 1); [ -z "$r" ] || printf '%s\n' "$o" | sed 1d | agentmux set waiting --reason "$r" --msg - --harness claude --pid $PPID
